releaseNotes.en: First version: your latest Twitch goal, live.
releaseNotes.fr: Première version : votre dernier objectif Twitch, en direct.

justifications.text: Reads the player's own goals with the integrated Twitch service and receives their live events; it writes nothing.
Reads the connected account's ID once, to read its goals.
Reads the goals when the live events are back after a cut, and every 20 seconds only while they are off.

reviewMessage: Test with any Twitch account connected in Connected services; create a goal in the creator dashboard and watch it update.
